quests.instruction: What is the action word for shaking very quickly with tiny, fast movements?
quests.question: Vibrate
quests.hint: Think about how a phone shakes with tiny, fast movements when it buzzes.
quests.explanation: Vibrate means to shake very quickly with tiny movements. A phone can vibrate when it buzzes!
quests.funFact: Your vocal cords vibrate quickly every single time you speak or sing!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for turning slowly all the way around a center point?
quests.question: Rotate
quests.hint: Think about a Ferris wheel turning slowly all the way around and around.
quests.explanation: Rotate means to turn slowly all the way around a center point. A Ferris wheel rotates slowly around!
quests.funFact: The Earth rotates all the way around once every twenty-four hours!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for moving in a circle around a bigger object in space?
quests.question: Orbit
quests.hint: Think about how the Moon travels in a big circle around the Earth.
quests.explanation: Orbit means to move in a circle around a bigger object. The Moon orbits around the Earth!
quests.funFact: It takes the Earth about one whole year to orbit around the Sun!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for a liquid slowly turning into an invisible gas in warm air?
quests.question: Evaporate
quests.hint: Think about a puddle slowly disappearing on a warm, sunny day.
quests.explanation: Evaporate means a liquid slowly turns into gas in warm air. A puddle can evaporate on a sunny day!
quests.funFact: Water evaporates from oceans and lakes to help form the clouds in our sky!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for a solid mixing completely into a liquid until it disappears?
quests.question: Dissolve
quests.hint: Think about stirring sugar into water until you cannot see it anymore.
quests.explanation: Dissolve means a solid mixes completely into a liquid. Sugar can dissolve in warm water!
quests.funFact: Even though sugar dissolves and disappears, it is still there making the water sweet!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for sleeping deeply through the whole winter?
quests.question: Hibernate
quests.hint: Think about a bear sleeping cozily in a cave all winter long.
quests.explanation: Hibernate means to sleep deeply through the whole winter. Bears hibernate in a cozy cave!
quests.funFact: Animals that hibernate save up energy in the fall to help them survive the winter!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for blending in with your surroundings so you are hard to see?
quests.question: Camouflage
quests.hint: Think about how a lizard's skin can match the color of the leaves around it.
quests.explanation: Camouflage means to blend in with your surroundings. A lizard can camouflage against green leaves!
quests.funFact: Many animals use camouflage to hide safely from other animals nearby!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for slowly changing to fit a new place or situation?
quests.question: Adapt
quests.hint: Think about how a plant slowly changes to survive in a very dry desert.
quests.explanation: Adapt means to slowly change to fit a new situation. A cactus can adapt to survive in a dry desert!
quests.funFact: Animals and plants adapt in clever ways to survive in all kinds of places!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for growing bigger or taking up more space?
quests.question: Expand
quests.hint: Think about how a balloon expands bigger and bigger as you blow air into it.
quests.explanation: Expand means to grow bigger or take up more space. A balloon can expand as you blow air into it!
quests.funFact: Most things expand a tiny bit when they get warmer!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for becoming smaller or taking up less space?
quests.question: Contract
quests.hint: Think about how a balloon shrinks smaller when air slowly leaks out.
quests.explanation: Contract means to become smaller or take up less space. A balloon can contract as air leaks out!
quests.funFact: Most things contract a tiny bit when they get colder!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for bouncing back light, like a mirror does?
quests.question: Reflect
quests.hint: Think about how a mirror bounces back your own picture when you look into it.
quests.explanation: Reflect means to bounce back light. A mirror reflects your picture back at you!
quests.funFact: Calm water can reflect the sky and clouds just like a giant mirror!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for soaking up a liquid?
quests.question: Absorb
quests.hint: Think about how a sponge soaks up water when you dip it in a puddle.
quests.explanation: Absorb means to soak up a liquid. A sponge can absorb a whole puddle of water!
quests.funFact: Plant roots absorb water from the soil to help the whole plant grow!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for changing completely into something new?
quests.question: Transform
quests.hint: Think about how a caterpillar changes completely into a beautiful butterfly.
quests.explanation: Transform means to change completely into something new. A caterpillar can transform into a butterfly!
quests.funFact: A caterpillar transforms inside a special cocoon called a chrysalis!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for putting two or more things together to make one thing?
quests.question: Combine
quests.hint: Think about putting flour, eggs, and sugar together to make cookie batter.
quests.explanation: Combine means to put two or more things together. We combine flour and eggs to make cookie batter!
quests.funFact: Combining simple ingredients in the right way can create something delicious!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making a number bigger by adding equal groups together?
quests.question: Multiply
quests.hint: Think about counting three groups of two apples all together at once.
quests.explanation: Multiply means to make a number bigger by adding equal groups. We multiply to count three groups of two apples!
quests.funFact: Multiplying is a fast way to add the same number many times!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for splitting something into equal, smaller parts?
quests.question: Divide
quests.hint: Think about splitting a pizza into equal slices to share with friends.
quests.explanation: Divide means to split something into equal parts. We divide a pizza into equal slices to share!
quests.funFact: Dividing something fairly makes sure everyone gets exactly the same amount!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for taking one number away from another?
quests.question: Subtract
quests.hint: Think about eating two cookies from a plate of five and counting how many are left.
quests.explanation: Subtract means to take one number away from another. We subtract two cookies from five to find how many are left!
quests.funFact: Subtracting is the opposite of adding numbers together!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for changing a number to a simpler, close number?
quests.question: Round
quests.hint: Think about changing a number like twenty-nine to an easier number like thirty.
quests.explanation: Round means to change a number to a simpler, close number. We round twenty-nine up to thirty!
quests.funFact: Rounding numbers can make big math problems much quicker to solve in your head!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for changing something from one form into another?
quests.question: Convert
quests.hint: Think about changing centimeters into inches to measure something a new way.
quests.explanation: Convert means to change something from one form into another. We convert centimeters into inches!
quests.funFact: Different countries convert between different units to measure length and weight!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for a tiny new plant beginning to grow from a seed?
quests.question: Sprout
quests.hint: Think about a tiny green shoot poking up out of the soil for the very first time.
quests.explanation: Sprout means a tiny new plant begins to grow. A seed can sprout after just a few days of water!
quests.funFact: Some seeds can sprout in just a few days with enough water and sunlight!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for a flower opening up to show its petals?
quests.question: Bloom
quests.hint: Think about a tightly closed flower bud slowly opening its colorful petals.
quests.explanation: Bloom means a flower opens up to show its petals. Tulips bloom beautifully in the spring!
quests.funFact: Many flowers bloom in spring when the weather turns warm and sunny!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for a tree or plant bursting into flower?
quests.question: Blossom
quests.hint: Think about a whole cherry tree suddenly covered in pink flowers in spring.
quests.explanation: Blossom means a tree or plant bursts into flower. Cherry trees blossom with pink flowers in spring!
quests.funFact: A tree covered in blossoms is one of the prettiest signs that spring has arrived!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for gathering ripe crops from a farm or garden?
quests.question: Harvest
quests.hint: Think about a farmer gathering ripe corn from a big field.
quests.explanation: Harvest means to gather ripe crops from a farm. Farmers harvest corn when it is ripe!
quests.funFact: Farmers harvest their crops at just the right time of year for the best flavor!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for fruit slowly becoming ready to eat?
quests.question: Ripen
quests.hint: Think about a green banana slowly turning yellow and sweet over a few days.
quests.explanation: Ripen means fruit slowly becomes ready to eat. A banana can ripen from green to yellow!
quests.funFact: Some fruits ripen faster when you keep them together in a bowl!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for a plant slowly drooping because it needs water?
quests.question: Wilt
quests.hint: Think about a flower slowly bending and drooping down when it gets too dry.
quests.explanation: Wilt means a plant slowly droops because it needs water. A flower can wilt if it does not get enough water!
quests.funFact: Giving a wilting plant some water can sometimes help it perk back up again!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for carrying tiny grains from flower to flower to help them make seeds?
quests.question: Pollinate
quests.hint: Think about a busy bee visiting flower after flower, covered in yellow dust.
quests.explanation: Pollinate means to carry tiny grains between flowers to help them make seeds. Bees pollinate flowers as they visit them!
quests.funFact: Bees pollinate an enormous number of the fruits and vegetables we eat!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making something easier to understand?
quests.question: Simplify
quests.hint: Think about explaining a hard idea using simple, easy words instead.
quests.explanation: Simplify means to make something easier to understand. We simplify a hard idea using simple words!
quests.funFact: Simplifying a tricky problem into smaller steps can make it feel much easier!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for explaining something again so it becomes clear?
quests.question: Clarify
quests.hint: Think about explaining the directions one more time so everyone understands.
quests.explanation: Clarify means to explain something again so it becomes clear. We clarify the directions so everyone understands!
quests.funFact: Asking a good question is a great way to clarify something confusing!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for checking that something is true or correct?
quests.question: Verify
quests.hint: Think about checking your math answer carefully to make sure it is correct.
quests.explanation: Verify means to check that something is true or correct. We verify our math answer before turning it in!
quests.funFact: Verifying your work carefully can help you feel confident it is correct!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making a change to improve or adjust something?
quests.question: Modify
quests.hint: Think about changing the rules of a game a little so it is more fun for everyone.
quests.explanation: Modify means to make a change to improve something. We modify the rules of a game to make it more fun!
quests.funFact: Modifying a plan slightly can sometimes make it work even better than before!
